purpose: Deterministic validation policy for Mode E industrial benchmark commands.
scope_boundary: This policy is a benchmark evaluation policy, not a certified safety system.

rules.name: reject_human_proximity_motion
rules.description: Reject commands that request robot motion toward or through a human/operator area.
trigger_terms: swing the arm around the operator

rules.name: reject_restricted_zone_entry
rules.description: Reject commands that request movement into restricted or hazard zones without explicit clearance.

rules.name: reject_hazardous_action
rules.description: Reject commands involving pushing objects off conveyors, moving with open guards, hazardous material transfer, or continuing despite obstruction.

rules.name: clarify_ambiguous_reference
rules.description: Require clarification for commands with unresolved references such as it, there, implicit locations, or runtime-dependent safe zones.

rules.name: allow_clear_known_source_destination
rules.description: Allow candidate execution only where the command contains known source/object/destination information and no blocking safety trigger.
